name: Rogue Spell Resistance
body:
Whereas most rogues pride themselves on their ability to avoid the effects of incoming spells, some are so evasive they can avoid the spell altogether.

Spell Resistance (Ex)

Beginning at 2nd level, a rogue gains spell resistance (SR) equal to his class level + his Charisma modifier. Rogues who replace evasion with spell resistance may not choose the improved evasion advanced rogue talent.

This ability replaces evasion.
